conditions.description: Exact installed native classes in the applied compatibility source set, legitimate native player owner or explicitly rider-confirmed JEM custody. Native inventories and serialized Forge capabilities retained without the old blanket exclusion.

Either home accepts every supported species regardless of size. Safe recovery requires intact loaded home, nearby player within32 blocks, authenticated owner and loaded full-body collision/habitat/protection clearance.

Ordinary delivery requires both final model exports, per-cell baked resources, shared collision data and matching MobHome on both sides. Current model work is source-reviewed, with user runtime acceptance unobserved. Optional food/HUD art is outside this shelter owner.

change.summary: Standalone Mob Home owns two size-independent homes and native recovery, with no required JEM/content mods

modifiers.before: No JEM shelter owner or companion assignment
modifiers.after: One pet per home and one home per pet; atomic reassignment, no size eligibility gate, no silent occupant eviction; unbind/removal retains dead pet native snapshot

modifiers.before: Native ordinary death and conventional loot; no JEM shelter recovery
modifiers.after: Confirmed death native snapshot/epoch journal before loot, narrow exceptional byproduct and competing-respawn adapters, same UUID/whole multipart chain recovered, pending retained until every real native chunk write and flush completes before ordinary simulation resumes

modifiers.before: Native cats/wolves can teleport to owner
modifiers.after: Only native post-recovery owner teleport seams pause until first owner interaction, ordinary navigation/AI/combat/mount control remains native

modifiers.before: Binding assigns a home but the loaded animal can remain elsewhere and move away before owner interaction.
modifiers.after: On Bind, a loaded same-dimension animal moves immediately to a collision-safe point inside or beside its home and remains there with native AI movement paused. The owner's first right click releases the hold. A missing safe loaded point rejects the Bind, and unbinding restores the original AI state.
modifiers.notes: The hold flag and previous NoAI state persist on the entity. Recovery and load reuse the same placement and release contract without forcing chunks.

modifiers.after: Small PSP/L L/PPP; large LRL/L L/PPP; vanilla tags plus shared shaped serializer validates same vanilla wood family, no upstream recipe mutation

Fresh epoch per attempt, interrupted native head/segment disk copies rejected, synchronous acknowledged native loaded-chunk serialization/flush precedes journal clear and simulation. Failure discards attempted live body while retaining durable native payload

Exact installed vanilla/Alex/pack classes use native owner first, ownerless mounts require current controlling-rider Bind custody. Living summons retain native secondary player owner, current native age and true expiry, with no reset or new permanence
All recruits namespace entities excluded from shelter discovery, binding and recovery. Native ownership, recruitment, death and teleport behavior remain native

modifiers.after: Independent mobhome Forge mod, own registrations, GUI, recipes, channel and mixins. Required runtime dependencies only Forge and Minecraft. Vanilla and each installed compatible adapter work independently. Recruits excluded

Native Java UVs and legal single-axis roof rotations retained. Solid slopes and triangular gables use conservative two-model-unit collision stairs. Production JAR and reobfuscation succeeded. User explicitly deferred local publication/application, runtime and performance acceptance remain unobserved

modifiers.before: Interior preferred for every size whenever full native collision permits
modifiers.after: Body height above1 block requires entire relocated body horizontally disjoint from the whole rotated home footprint, including roof columns. Small pets retain interior-first. Shared loaded-only full-body habitat/support/claims8-horizontal32-up8-down search and pending payload retained

rationale.purpose: Implement the user's two-size, mandatory-GUI, any-size-pet shelter recovery contract without inventing pet progression, duplicating native mod resurrection or forcing chunk loads.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-23 explicitly requires all installed mountables/tameables/companions, actual local Gemini use, and non-art completion excluding clock/season icons and models. Codex chose exact installed adapters, rider-confirmed custody and synchronous native write/flush with fresh epoch retries. Gemini advice was checked against installed bytecode. User then explicitly excludes Recruits from homes. Codex removes shelter adapters and retires legacy assignments without deleting captured native payloads; User2026-10-24 requires standalone Mob Home and optional integrations, then requests a ZIP for manual Antigravity model production. Codex chose a complete single-owner extraction and retained native journal keys for durable data compatibility. User2026-10-24 rejected script-generated Antigravity models, explicitly authorized Codex visual production, selected the small stone-house direction, and then asked to optimize both houses while preserving appearance and removing board gaps. Codex chose editable native Blockbench/Aseprite sources, static baked per-cell packaging and cached collision from those same native exports. Exact task-owned outputs and runtime acceptance remain distinct.
